lead: A string literal folds into a unit's data section; an *object* does not follow from that, because its second header word is an identity rather than a payload.
body: `immortal_header_bytes` needs only the bytes, while an instance needs a `*const ClassDesc` — and a `Core` class's was leaked once per core, so no single address existed for a unit every core reads to bake in. Before carrying the immortal-string precedent to another representation, ask what else its header holds and where that word's identity comes from.
